_doc: Bo loc Tuyet - cau hinh v1. Chinh bang web/snow-tuner.html roi bam Luu, dat file nay canh snow.exe. style = kieu tuyet: v1 = ban dau (dia bokeh sang, co quang), v2 = tuyet that (lop phu cum tuyet sac phia truoc); doi kieu tren trang chinh se nap bo thong so cua kieu do. amount = luong tuyet (%, nhan so hat moi lop). vary = bien thien giua cac anh (+/- luong tuyet %, huong gio do, so bokeh %, co hat %, do tu dam). seed 0 = moi anh mot bo hat rieng (theo ten file). camera: ong kinh AO de tinh do mo cua tuyet (met, mm). layers: lens = sat ong kinh, front = truoc mat mau, focus = quanh mau, behind = sau lung mau (bi nguoi che), far = xa trong phong. flakes.real = ty le cum tuyet that. overlay = lop phu phia truoc: cum tuyet that sac, rai khap khung (amount %, minMm/maxMm, blur 0-100 = do trai sau). settle = tuyet dong tren nguoi (mac dinh tat) (can subject.mode auto): amount %, minMm/maxMm = co manh (mm), crown = don tren dinh dau/vai, scatter = rai tren toc/ao, frost = tinh the li ti; da mat khong dinh tuyet. subject.mode: auto = tach nguoi tu dong; subject.model: modnet (nhanh, ~0.5 s) hoac birefnet (dep hon, ~5 s/tam, tai bang: npm run model -- birefnet), neu khong chay duoc thi dung elip x/y/w/h (%); ellipse = luon dung elip; off = khong che. look: chinh mau SAU khi rac tuyet, cung bo cong cu voi Instax (enabled = bat/tat, strength = do dam); LUT .cube dat trong thu muc luts canh snow.exe. retouch: nhat mun + lam min da, chay TRUOC tuyet (enabled = bat/tat; blemish = nhat mun; blemishMethod: capture-one = Retouch v1, model Remove Blemishes cua Capture One trong models/mun; c1-mask = Retouch v2, mat na da Capture One + bo chua mun tu viet (chi can skinMasking.onnx); thieu model thi tu dung builtin = bo tu viet; blemishAmount 0-100; smooth = do min 0-100, 0 = khong lam min, nhe 30 / vua 60 / manh 90; dodgeBurn = to sang / toi kieu neutral gray 0-100 (lam deu da, quang tham mat, ranh mui-mieng), 0 = tat, mac dinh 30, can models/facemesh-v2.onnx (npm run model -- facemesh); contour = tao khoi theo cung muc dodgeBurn; device = may chay model Capture One: auto (mac dinh, snow.exe tinh ca thoi gian nap GPU - thuong chay mat na da tren CPU, nhanh hon ~1 s/tam), gpu (cach cu: may chay nhanh nhat), cpu).
